# docker_stack (Resource)

A Swarm stack built from API primitives (not a compose file, no CLI): services, overlay networks, secrets and configs, each named `<stack>_<name>` and labelled `com.docker.stack.namespace=<stack>` so `docker stack ls/ps` show them. Requires the provider to point at a Swarm manager. Apply creates networks, secrets and configs first, then services, whose `networks`/`secrets`/`configs` references may use the short names of the stack's own objects. Updates diff the stack's labelled objects against the configuration: missing objects are created, services are updated in place (recreated when `mode` switches type), changed secrets/configs/networks are replaced after removing the services that use them, and objects no longer configured are removed. Destroy removes services first (waiting for their tasks to go), then secrets, configs and networks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every object is created as "shop_<name>" and labelled
# com.docker.stack.namespace=shop, so `docker stack ps shop` shows it.
resource "docker_stack" "shop" {
  name = "shop"

  network {
    name       = "backend"
    attachable = true
  }

  # Not pre-created: tasks create "shop_pgdata" on their node on first use.
  volume {
    name   = "pgdata"
    driver = "local"
  }

  secret {
    name = "db_password"
    data = base64encode("change-me")
  }

  config {
    name = "nginx"
    data = base64encode("server { listen 80; location / { proxy_pass http://api:8080; } }")
  }

  service {
    name     = "db"
    image    = "postgres:16-alpine"
    networks = ["backend"] # stack-local short name

    env = {
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE = "/run/secrets/db_password"
    }

    mounts {
      type   = "volume"
      source = "pgdata" # stack volume short name
      target = "/var/lib/postgresql/data"
    }

    secrets {
      secret_id = "db_password" # stack secret short name
    }

    placement {
      constraints = ["node.role==manager"]
    }
  }

  service {
    name     = "web"
    image    = "nginx:1.27-alpine"
    replicas = 2
    networks = ["backend"]

    configs {
      config_id = "nginx"
      file_name = "/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf"
    }

    endpoint_spec {
      ports {
        target_port    = 80
        published_port = 80
      }
    }

    converge_config {}
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stack namespace. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `config` (Block List) A Swarm config created as `<stack>_<name>`. Services reference it by its short `name`. configs are immutable: a change removes the services using it, replaces the config and recreates those services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--config))
- `network` (Block List) A network created as `<stack>_<name>` (swarm scope). A change replaces it after removing the services attached to it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--network))
- `secret` (Block List) A Swarm secret created as `<stack>_<name>`. Services reference it by its short `name`. secrets are immutable: a change removes the services using it, replaces the secret and recreates those services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--secret))
- `service` (Block List) A service of the stack, created as `<stack>_<name>` with the same settings as `docker_service`. Tasks get a network alias of the short name on every network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service))
- `volume` (Block List) A named volume `<stack>_<name>`. Swarm cannot pre-create volumes across nodes, so nothing is created up front: every service mount of `type = "volume"` whose `source` is this short name is rewritten to `<stack>_<name>` with this driver, options and labels, and each node's daemon creates the volume when a task first uses it. Volumes are not removed on destroy (like `docker stack rm`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--volume))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stack name.

<a id="nestedblock--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Required:

- `data` (String) Content, base64-encoded (use `base64encode()`). Kept from state on refresh.
- `name` (String) Short name inside the stack.

Optional:

- `labels` (Map of String) User labels.


<a id="nestedblock--network"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network`

Required:

- `name` (String) Short name inside the stack.

Optional:

- `attachable` (Boolean) Let standalone containers attach.
- `driver` (String) Network driver (default `overlay`).
- `internal` (Boolean) No external connectivity.
- `labels` (Map of String) User labels.
- `options` (Map of String) Driver options.


<a id="nestedblock--secret"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secret`

Required:

- `data` (String, Sensitive) Content, base64-encoded (use `base64encode()`). Kept from state on refresh.
- `name` (String) Short name inside the stack.

Optional:

- `labels` (Map of String) User labels.


<a id="nestedblock--service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service`

Required:

- `image` (String) Image reference the tasks run. The provider asks the registry for the digest and the daemon pins tasks to it (`@sha256:...`); that pin is ignored on refresh when this value has no digest. Credentials come from the provider's `registry_auth`. Updated in place (rolling update).
- `name` (String) Short service name inside the stack; the Swarm service is named `<stack>_<name>`. Renaming removes the old service and creates a new one.

Optional:

- `args` (List of String) Arguments passed to the command (overrides the image `CMD`).
- `cap_add` (Set of String) Linux capabilities to add to the task containers, e.g. `NET_ADMIN` (case and `CAP_` prefix are ignored when comparing). Updated in place.
- `cap_drop` (Set of String) Linux capabilities to drop, e.g. `ALL`. Updated in place.
- `command` (List of String) Command to run (overrides the image `ENTRYPOINT`).
- `configs` (Block List) Swarm configs mounted as files in the task containers (default path `/run/secrets/<file_name>` for secrets, `/<file_name>` for configs). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--configs))
- `container_labels` (Map of String) Labels on the task containers.
- `converge_config` (Block, Optional) When present, create and update wait until the service has converged: the wanted number of tasks running (every desired task for `global`) and no update paused or rolling back; for `replicated_job`, `total_completions` tasks completed; for `global_job`, every task of the current run finished with at least one completed. On timeout the apply fails with the task errors. Not sent to the daemon. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--converge_config))
- `dir` (String) Working directory of the task process. Unset uses the image's. Updated in place.
- `dns` (Block, Optional) Resolver configuration of the task containers (`ContainerSpec.DNSConfig`). Updated in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--dns))
- `endpoint_spec` (Block, Optional) How the service is reached: resolution mode and published ports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--endpoint_spec))
- `env` (Map of String) Environment variables of the task containers.
- `force_update` (Number) Counter (`TaskTemplate.ForceUpdate`): change it (e.g. increment) to force a rolling restart of every task even when nothing else changed, like `docker service update --force`. Unset leaves the daemon's counter alone and ignores it on refresh. Updated in place.
- `healthcheck` (Block, Optional) Container healthcheck; Swarm only counts healthy tasks as running. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--healthcheck))
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the task containers (`ContainerSpec.Hostname`; Go templates such as `{{.Task.Name}}` work). Unset: the container ID prefix. Updated in place (rolling update).
- `hosts` (List of String) Extra `/etc/hosts` entries, each `"<hostname>:<ip>"` like `docker service create --host`. The provider sends them in the daemon's `"<ip> <hostname>"` (hosts(5)) format; an entry that already contains a space is sent as is. Updated in place.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels on the service object.
- `logging` (Block, Optional) Log driver of the task containers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--logging))
- `max_concurrent` (Number) `replicated_job` only: tasks run at the same time (daemon default 1). Updated in place (re-runs the job).
- `mode` (String) `replicated` (default), `global`, `replicated_job` or `global_job` (see `docker_service`). Changing it recreates this service.
- `mounts` (Block List) Mounts in the task containers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--mounts))
- `networks` (Set of String) Networks to attach the tasks to, by ID or name (resolved to IDs; overlay networks). In a stack, the short name of a stack `network` block resolves to `<stack>_<name>`. Use `networks_advanced` instead for per-network aliases; the two cannot be combined. Updated in place.
- `networks_advanced` (Block List) Networks to attach, with per-network DNS aliases (`TaskTemplate.Networks[].Aliases`). An alternative to `networks`: setting both is an error. Updated in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--networks_advanced))
- `placement` (Block, Optional) Where tasks may run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--placement))
- `replicas` (Number) Number of tasks for `replicated` mode (default 1); ignored by the other modes. Updated in place.
- `resources` (Block, Optional) CPU and memory limits and reservations per task. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--resources))
- `restart_policy` (Block, Optional) When Swarm restarts tasks that exit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--restart_policy))
- `rollback_config` (Block, Optional) How a failed update rolls back. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--rollback_config))
- `secrets` (Block List) Swarm secrets mounted as files in the task containers (default path `/run/secrets/<file_name>` for secrets, `/<file_name>` for configs). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--secrets))
- `stop_grace_period` (String) Time to wait after the stop signal before killing a task (Go duration, e.g. `30s`; daemon default 10s). Updated in place.
- `sysctls` (Map of String) Namespaced kernel parameters for the task containers, e.g. `{ "net.core.somaxconn" = "1024" }`. Updated in place.
- `total_completions` (Number) `replicated_job` only: tasks that must complete successfully (daemon default: `max_concurrent`). Updated in place (re-runs the job).
- `ulimits` (Block List) Resource ulimits of the task containers. Updated in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--ulimits))
- `update_config` (Block, Optional) How a changed service rolls out to its tasks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--update_config))
- `user` (String) User (`uid`, `name`, optionally `:group`) the task process runs as. Unset uses the image's. Updated in place.

<a id="nestedblock--service--configs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.configs`

Required:

- `config_id` (String) ID or name of the config (resolved to its ID). In a stack, the short name of a stack `config` block resolves to `<stack>_<name>`.

Optional:

- `config_name` (String) Name of the config; looked up from the ID when unset.
- `file_name` (String) File name (or absolute path) in the container. Defaults to the reference as written when it is a name, otherwise the config name.
- `gid` (String) File group GID (default `0`).
- `mode` (Number) File mode as a decimal number (default `292`, i.e. `0444`).
- `uid` (String) File owner UID (default `0`).


<a id="nestedblock--service--converge_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.converge_config`

Optional:

- `delay` (String) Poll interval (Go duration, default `5s`).
- `timeout` (String) Maximum wait (Go duration, default `3m`).


<a id="nestedblock--service--dns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.dns`

Optional:

- `nameservers` (List of String) DNS server IPs.
- `options` (List of String) resolv.conf options, e.g. `ndots:2`.
- `search` (List of String) DNS search domains.


<a id="nestedblock--service--endpoint_spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.endpoint_spec`

Optional:

- `mode` (String) `vip` (default, a virtual IP load-balances tasks) or `dnsrr` (DNS round robin).
- `ports` (Block List) Published ports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--endpoint_spec--ports))

<a id="nestedblock--service--endpoint_spec--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.endpoint_spec.ports`

Required:

- `target_port` (Number) Port inside the tasks.

Optional:

- `protocol` (String) `tcp` (default), `udp` or `sctp`.
- `publish_mode` (String) `ingress` (default, routing mesh on every node) or `host` (only on nodes running a task).
- `published_port` (Number) Port published on the nodes. Unset lets Swarm choose one (30000+).



<a id="nestedblock--service--healthcheck"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.healthcheck`

Optional:

- `interval` (String) Time between checks (Go duration).
- `retries` (Number) Consecutive failures before unhealthy.
- `start_period` (String) Start-up grace period (Go duration).
- `test` (List of String) Test command, e.g. `["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost/"]`, `["CMD-SHELL", "..."]` or `["NONE"]`.
- `timeout` (String) Time before a check counts as hung (Go duration).


<a id="nestedblock--service--logging"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.logging`

Optional:

- `driver` (String) Log driver name, e.g. `json-file`.
- `options` (Map of String) Log driver options.


<a id="nestedblock--service--mounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.mounts`

Required:

- `target` (String) Path inside the container.
- `type` (String) `bind`, `volume` or `tmpfs`.

Optional:

- `read_only` (Boolean) Mount read-only.
- `source` (String) Host path (`bind`) or volume name (`volume`; created on each node by the volume driver if missing). In a stack, the short name of a stack `volume` block resolves to `<stack>_<name>` with that block's driver, options and labels.
- `tmpfs_size` (Number) Size of a `tmpfs` mount in bytes.
- `volume_driver` (String) Volume driver used when the volume does not exist yet on the node.
- `volume_driver_opts` (Map of String) Driver options for a volume created on first use.
- `volume_labels` (Map of String) Labels for a volume created on first use.


<a id="nestedblock--service--networks_advanced"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.networks_advanced`

Required:

- `name` (String) Network ID or name (resolved to its ID). In a stack, the short name of a stack `network` block resolves to `<stack>_<name>`.

Optional:

- `aliases` (Set of String) Extra DNS names the service gets on this network (the service name always resolves).


<a id="nestedblock--service--placement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.placement`

Optional:

- `constraints` (List of String) Constraints such as `node.role==manager` or `node.labels.zone==a`.
- `max_replicas` (Number) Maximum tasks per node; 0 or unset means unlimited.
- `preferences` (List of String) Spread preferences, each `spread=<descriptor>` such as `spread=node.labels.zone`.


<a id="nestedblock--service--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.resources`

Optional:

- `limits` (Block, Optional) Hard limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--resources--limits))
- `reservations` (Block, Optional) Reservations the scheduler must find on a node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service--resources--reservations))

<a id="nestedblock--service--resources--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.resources.limits`

Optional:

- `memory_bytes` (Number) Memory in bytes.
- `nano_cpus` (Number) CPU in units of 1e-9 CPUs (1000000000 = one CPU).


<a id="nestedblock--service--resources--reservations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.resources.reservations`

Optional:

- `memory_bytes` (Number) Memory in bytes.
- `nano_cpus` (Number) CPU in units of 1e-9 CPUs (1000000000 = one CPU).



<a id="nestedblock--service--restart_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.restart_policy`

Optional:

- `condition` (String) `none`, `on-failure` or `any` (default).
- `delay` (String) Delay between restart attempts (Go duration, e.g. `5s`).
- `max_attempts` (Number) Maximum restarts before giving up; 0 or unset means unlimited.
- `window` (String) Window used to evaluate the restart policy (Go duration).


<a id="nestedblock--service--rollback_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.rollback_config`

Optional:

- `delay` (String) Delay between batches (Go duration).
- `failure_action` (String) `pause` (default), `continue` or `rollback`.
- `max_failure_ratio` (Number) Fraction of tasks that may fail before `failure_action` triggers (0 to 1).
- `monitor` (String) Time to watch each task for failure after it starts (Go duration).
- `order` (String) `stop-first` (default) or `start-first`.
- `parallelism` (Number) Tasks updated at once (default 1; 0 means all at once).


<a id="nestedblock--service--secrets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.secrets`

Required:

- `secret_id` (String) ID or name of the secret (resolved to its ID). In a stack, the short name of a stack `secret` block resolves to `<stack>_<name>`.

Optional:

- `file_name` (String) File name (or absolute path) in the container. Defaults to the reference as written when it is a name, otherwise the secret name.
- `gid` (String) File group GID (default `0`).
- `mode` (Number) File mode as a decimal number (default `292`, i.e. `0444`).
- `secret_name` (String) Name of the secret; looked up from the ID when unset.
- `uid` (String) File owner UID (default `0`).


<a id="nestedblock--service--ulimits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.ulimits`

Required:

- `hard` (Number) Hard limit.
- `name` (String) Ulimit name, e.g. `nofile`.
- `soft` (Number) Soft limit.


<a id="nestedblock--service--update_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service.update_config`

Optional:

- `delay` (String) Delay between batches (Go duration).
- `failure_action` (String) `pause` (default), `continue` or `rollback`.
- `max_failure_ratio` (Number) Fraction of tasks that may fail before `failure_action` triggers (0 to 1).
- `monitor` (String) Time to watch each task for failure after it starts (Go duration).
- `order` (String) `stop-first` (default) or `start-first`.
- `parallelism` (Number) Tasks updated at once (default 1; 0 means all at once).



<a id="nestedblock--volume"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volume`

Required:

- `name` (String) Short name inside the stack.

Optional:

- `driver` (String) Volume driver (daemon default `local`).
- `driver_opts` (Map of String) Driver options.
- `labels` (Map of String) Volume labels.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by stack name (the com.docker.stack.namespace label value). Secret
# data cannot be read back and volume blocks are not daemon objects, so add
# them to the configuration; the next apply replaces secrets once.
terraform import docker_stack.shop shop
```
